scope: Season-board observations whose explicit per-90 source key conflicts with a recognized title denominator.

conflict_policy.unit: unverified unless the base percent/rating/currency definition is independently retained
conflict_policy.value_policy: preserve the finite source value; do not round, divide or recompute

missing_evidence_policy: Do not infer a season total from a familiar metric name or infer a denominator from the absence of per-match wording.
collection_policy: Retain the source board title, format, decimal hint and category in private raw metadata; missing source metadata remains null.
history_policy: No historical source rewrite or fabricated metadata backfill. Existing non-conflicting observations retain definition v1.
